cohort: 210 singleton pregnant women at BIRDEM general Hospital in Bangladesh, with 105 experiencing adverse birth outcomes (cases) and 105 not experiencing adverse birth outcomes (controls).
finding: Advanced maternal age, pregnancy-induced hypertension, premature rupture of membrane, and previous caesarian section were associated with adverse birth outcomes.
mod_finding: Previous caesarian section was associated with preterm labor.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was measured as an outcome.
